function.description: Retrieves the list of rules within a specific rule-based compliance (RBC) policy (path param `policyId`). Use this when the user asks what rules a compliance/RBC policy contains, or how a policy works / is implemented / is enforced (its rules, then their conditions via api_getComplianceConditions) — including short follow-ups in a compliance conversation like 'how is it implemented?' or 'how does that policy work?'. When the question refers to a policy discussed earlier ('it' / 'that policy'), reuse that same policy. Resolve `policyId` from the policy name using api_getCompliancePolicies first.
function.name: api_getComplianceRules

limit.description: Maximum number of records to be fetched. If not provided, 500 records will be fetched by default

offset.description: The first record to show for this page. Minimum value is 1

items.description: This schema defines the structure of a rule.

conditionsCount.description: The total number of conditions present within the rule.

description.description: A comprehensive description of the rule. This should provide detailed information about what the rule does, its scope, and any other pertinent details that explain its function and purpose.

deviceRoles.description: Specifies the roles of the network devices to which the rule applies. If value is not provided, the rule will apply to all device roles.

items.description: Role assigned to the network device.

deviceTypes.description: Defines device types by detailing their family, series, and model to enable the application of rules to targeted devices.

deviceModel.description: The device model. When a device model is specified, `deviceSeries` is required.

impact.description: This describes the potential impact when the conditions of this rule are violated.
impact.example: Notes on the impact of this rule.

name.description: This is the name of the rule. It should be a concise and descriptive title that clearly identifies the rule's purpose or function. The name must be unique within the specified policy.

softwareType.description:
Specifies the software type applicable to the rule. The options include:
  - `IOS`: Cisco Internetwork Operating System.
  - `IOS_XE`: Cisco IOS-XE software.
  - `CISCO_CONTROLLER`: AireOS operating system for Cisco wireless controllers.

suggestedFix.description: Suggestions on how to fix the issues detected by this rule.

variablesCount.description: The total number of variables present within the rule.

items.title: Rule
